reason: The README clearly describes an AI-assisted Japanese singing synthesis plugin that creates scores and renders WAV audio through a locally installed STUDIO NEUTRINO engine, with voicebank management and output listing.

summaries.zh: 通过 STUDIO NEUTRINO 将歌词和旋律生成乐谱并渲染为角色演唱的 WAV 音频，同时提供声库管理和输出查询工具。
summaries.en: Creates scores from lyrics and melodies and renders character singing as WAV audio through STUDIO NEUTRINO, with voicebank management and output listing tools.

capabilities: Generates MusicXML scores from lyrics and melodies
Invokes the locally installed STUDIO NEUTRINO engine to render WAV audio
Imports voicebanks from official ZIP archives
Reads engine, voicebank, and recent output status
Writes score and rendered audio files to local directories
